# mehyar.jobs

mehyar.jobs (https://jobs.mehyar.us/) is a free AI job-matching service by MehyarSoft LLC. Every day it scans public career pages across Fortune 500, Forbes Global 2000, Inc 5000, and S&P 500 companies — thousands of employers in every industry. Upload your resume once and the engine fit-scores every posting against your skills, titles, and experience, ranking your best matches first. Free toolkit: ATS Mirror (0–100 ATS-readiness audit of your resume), Resume Studio (tailor a resume to any role), and AI resume review (0–100 hireability score).

## Key pages

- / — landing page and job browsing (no account needed to browse)
- /signup — create a free account
- /login — log in
- /ats-mirror — free ATS resume audit
- /review — AI resume review
- /studio — free Resume Studio
- /about — how the service works
- /advertise — employers: feature a job to matched candidates
- /recruiter-match — opt in to recruiter matching
- /unsubscribe — one-click unsubscribe, no login needed
- /privacy — privacy policy
- /terms — terms of service
- /job/<id>-<slug> — individual job detail pages (server-rendered, crawler-friendly)
- /jobs/browse — browse live jobs by title and city

## Pricing

Free for job seekers, always. Browsing, fit-scored matches, daily job alerts, the ATS Mirror audit, Resume Studio, and AI resume review are all free — no credit card required. Employers and advertisers pay to feature jobs (see /advertise); that keeps the service free.

## API

Public, no-auth endpoints:
- GET /api/public/stats — public stats: companies tracked, active jobs, jobs posted today, industry breakdown
- GET /api/public/health — health probe
- POST /api/public/free-run — one free anonymous resume check per visitor (IP-hashed)
- POST /api/public/parse-resume — parse an uploaded resume into a candidate profile

## Compliance

mehyar.jobs is a job-discovery and resume-analysis tool. It does not claim to guarantee interviews, job offers, or employment outcomes — fit scores and ATS scores are estimates, not promises of hiring success. Listings are aggregated from public employer career pages; always verify details and apply through the original posting. Marketing emails are double opt-in with one-click unsubscribe and a physical mailing address (CAN-SPAM compliant).
